run_json_data_generation: run the script to convert pickled mention data into per-dataset JSONL files for entity linking
convert_pickle_to_jsonl: convert a pickled mention data file into JSONL format grouped by dataset name
extract_mention_context: extract previous, current, and next sentence context for each mention in the dataset
keep_pregenerated_candidates: run the script with the keep_pregenerated_candidates flag to include baseline candidates for comparison
dump_processed_mentions: dump processed mentions with gold labels, candidates, and tagged context to JSONL files
